_findings.errexit does not apply to a `!`-inverted: THE defect class of round 21, and it invalidated three of my own fixes from the same day. bash(1) under `set -e` exempts 'any command in a pipeline but the last, or if the command's return value is being inverted with !'. So `set -e; ! grep -q x <<<x; echo REACHED` prints REACHED. Every `! grep` in these Containerfiles is written as a build-time refusal and 46 of them failed nothing — they are mid-stanza, so their status is discarded and the build only ever stops if some LATER command in the same RUN fails. Found by the p1-063 lid agent in its own stanza; it wrote its refusals as `if ... exit 1` from the start and that is the idiom adopted. Ten of the 46 are not greps and were never in reach of the resolver at all: `apex-mux nonsense-verb`, `apex vm create --graphics spice`, `apex secret --help`, `apex recover reset` as root, `command -v qemu-system-x86_64` — all carrying real security decisions and asserting nothing.
